name: makarasty-tools
description: Twelve everyday commands: commit and ship under your own name, review a diff with evidence, hand a chat off before its context runs out, collect bugs until a codeword, explain plainly, strip assistant tics from text, phrase a vendor call in simple English, get a phone message when a chat finishes, tune the machine for a game, find what is worth updating and clean up what nobody uses. A hook suggests a handoff once a chat passes 700k tokens of context.
